# Apache ECharts

- Package: `echarts@6.0.0`, Apache ECharts.
- Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@6.0.0/dist/echarts.min.js` (npm distribution).
- Official documentation: `https://echarts.apache.org/en/llms.txt`.
- Unmodified distribution, served locally so the replay does not depend on a runtime CDN.
- `echarts-LICENSE.txt` and `echarts-NOTICE.txt` accompany the bundle.
- Used for candlestick and volume series, linked axes and date zoom in the agriculture replay.
